description.value:
Usage drawn on a creature

A ring of dotted circles, this rune allows a creature marked with it to see all. The target is affected by @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.jwK43yKsHTkJQvQ9]{see the unseen} and gains all-around vision, which prevents it from being flanked.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-runesmith-assistant.pf2e-runesmith-assistant-items.Item.uSvACOQ3Ib7d311G]{Effect: Ichelsu, Rune of Observation}

Invocation The eyes of the rune fly outwards, attaching to all creatures in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:20]. Each of these creatures that was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible} becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} instead, and each one that was @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} for any other reason is no longer concealed. This effect lasts for 2 rounds.
